description:
Reentrancy in PvPArena.claimTimeout(uint256) (contracts/games/PvPArena.sol#199-221):
	External calls:
	- (successA,None) = address(room.playerA).call{value: amount}() (contracts/games/PvPArena.sol#214)
	- (successB,None) = address(room.playerB).call{value: amount}() (contracts/games/PvPArena.sol#217)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- pendingWithdrawals[room.playerB] += amount (contracts/games/PvPArena.sol#218)
	PvPArena.pendingWithdrawals (contracts/games/PvPArena.sol#46) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- PvPArena.fulfillRandomWords(uint256,uint256[]) (contracts/games/PvPArena.sol#240-272)
	- PvPArena.pendingWithdrawals (contracts/games/PvPArena.sol#46)
triage_note: Reviewed 2026-10-01: room status is finalized before any external call, claimTimeout and withdrawPending are nonReentrant, and pendingWithdrawals is only credited when a send fails.
